units.title: Digital Logic
topics: Number systems: Binary, Octal, Hexadecimal, BCD, ASCII, EBCDIC, Gray codes
Binary arithmetic, complements (1's and 2's), Boolean algebra, Venn diagrams
Logic gates: truth tables, SOP & POS forms, K-map simplification
Combinational circuits: Adder, Subtractor, Encoder, Decoder, Multiplexer, Comparator, Parity Generator
Memory systems: RAM, ROM, EPROM, EEPROM, PLDs & PLAs
Sequential circuits: Flip-Flops (SR, JK, D, T), Registers, Counters, State diagrams
A/D and D/A conversion, Logic families (TTL, ECL, MOS, CMOS)

units.title: Computer Organization & Architecture
topics: Number systems and conversions, Binary arithmetic
Error detection/correction codes (Parity, Checksum, Hamming code)
ASCII, EBCDIC, Gray code, BCD
CPU organisation, Addressing modes, RAM (SRAM, DRAM), ROM (PROM, EPROM, EEPROM)
Microprocessor & Microcontroller basics
Logic gates, K-map simplification, ALU design

units.title: Programming & Data Structures
topics: Data types, Abstract data types, Algorithm design techniques
Arrays (1D, 2D, Sparse Matrices), Recursion & Backtracking
Linked lists: Single, Double, Circular, Polynomial operations
Stack: operations, applications (prefix/postfix evaluation)
Queue: Circular, Dequeue, Priority Queue
Searching: Linear, Binary, Hashing
Sorting: Insertion, Selection, Bubble, Heap, Counting, Bucket
Trees: Binary Trees, BST, AVL, B-Tree, Huffman Coding
Graphs: Representation, DFS, BFS

units.title: Algorithms
topics: Time & space complexity, Big-O notation, recurrence relations
Divide & Conquer: Binary search, Merge sort
Dynamic Programming basics
Graph algorithms (shortest path, MST basics)
NP-completeness (conceptual level only)

units.title: Operating System
topics: Functions, structure, and types of OS
Process concept: states, scheduling algorithms, process synchronization
Deadlock: conditions, prevention, avoidance, detection
Memory management: Paging, Segmentation, Virtual memory
File system: organisation, allocation methods, directories, I/O management
Protection, security, and recovery basics

units.title: Database Management System
topics: DBMS vs File system, Three-level (ANSI-SPARC) architecture
Relational model: keys, ER model, schema, relational algebra basics
Normalization: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF
Transactions, concurrency control, locking protocols, two-phase commit

units.title: Computer Networks
topics: Network topologies, reference models (OSI, TCP/IP)
Data transmission, encoding, compression, transmission impairments
Data link layer: framing, flow control, error control
Network layer: routing, congestion control, IPv4, ARP
Transport & application layers: UDP, TCP, HTTP, FTP, SMTP

units.title: Software Engineering
topics: Characteristics of software, process models: Waterfall, Spiral, Prototype
Project estimation: LOC, Function Points, COCOMO
SRS documentation, structured & object-oriented design
Testing: Unit, System, Black-box, White-box
Software quality and maintenance basics

units.title: Object-Oriented Programming
topics: Classes, objects, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism
Constructors, destructors, abstract classes & methods
Exception handling basics

units.title: Web-Based Application Development
topics: Internet basics, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery fundamentals
Introductory Node.js, Git basics, PHP, MySQL integration
DOM, XML basics, Sessions, HTTP forms

units.title: Theory of Computation
topics: DFA, NFA, Regular expressions, Minimization of Finite Automata
Context-Free Grammar, CNF, GNF, Pushdown Automata
Turing Machines, Recursive languages, Halting problem (conceptual)

units.title: Internet of Things (IoT)
topics: IoT architecture, Middleware, Protocols (Zigbee, Modbus, RFID)
Cloud & Mobile Computing basics in IoT context
Industrial IoT (IIoT), Security & Privacy basics

units.title: Artificial Intelligence
topics: Problem-solving, Search strategies (DFS, BFS, Hill Climbing)
Knowledge representation: Predicate logic, Frames, Rules
Inference: Forward & Backward chaining, Bayesian networks basics
Planning, Machine Learning basics, Expert Systems

units.title: Fundamentals of E-Commerce
topics: E-commerce framework and applications
Internet infrastructure, Firewalls, Network security basics
Payment systems: Smart cards, Credit cards, Digital tokens
EDI, Digital libraries, Corporate data warehouses

units.title: Multimedia
topics: Multimedia basics: Hardware, Software, Applications
Audio (MP3, MIDI), Graphics, Text, Animation, Video basics
Multimedia project design, Tools, and Future trends
